title: Accounting Analyst, General Accounting
description:
Accounting Analyst, General Accounting KPMG Jamaica (JESS) Kingston and St. Andrew / St. Catherine Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 19/11/2026 HR Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save JOB SUMMARY: 
The JESS General Accounting resources are responsible for performing various tasks in accordance with standard operating procedures provided by the Clients’ General Accounting team including but not limited to preparation of reconciliations and analysis. OVERVIEW: KPMG Jamaica has a delivery center named “Jamaica Extended Support Services (JESS)” operating from Kingston, which is contracted to provide back-office support to its member firm KPMG United States (“the Client”). The Clients’ Finance and Accounting is expanding operations at JESS to support the General Accounting process area. Team members within the delivery center work with Client’s stakeholders under a team extension model to support Client’s back-office operations. The Clients’ General Accounting process area performs tasks related to General Ledger activities. JOB SUMMARY: The JESS General Accounting resources are responsible for performing various tasks in accordance with standard operating procedures provided by the Clients’ General Accounting team including but not limited to preparation of reconciliations and analysis for various general ledger accounts, preparing and posting of journal entries and interpreting of financial data to ensure that journal entries and balances are correct. This role ensures accuracy in financial reporting, compliance with accounting standards and standard operating procedures and provides insights to support our Clients. Strong problem-solving skills to analyze and resolve reconciliation and financial analysis issues and ability to handle complex questions from various leaders and departments that go beyond set operating procedures are required. This role will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) over specific areas of the General Accounting function. The JESS Accounting Analyst reports primarily to the JESS General Accounting Manager but will also take directions from other Finance and Accounting Client team members who are accountable for the supported work. Example in comments: JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Service Delivery Responsible for maintaining the general ledger accounts related to balance sheet and other analyses. Prepare and book monthly journal entries, including prepaids, accruals, etc. Perform and review account reconciliations, investigating and correcting reconciling items. Conducting daily research and follow up for journal entries posted for medium/high complexity balance sheet and expense analysis accounts. Analyze and interpret accounting records to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement. Prepares special moderate to complex reports and analyses. Prepare and complete review of journal entries from team members while ensuring adequate support is maintained. Manage accounting for fixed assets, including asset creation, depreciation, and reconciliation. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure efficient financial operations and process improvements. Performs quality assurance review of other team members’ work product and ensures that it meets Client’s expectations and deadlines. Feedback on reviews should be shared with Team Lead/Asst. Manager. Conduct annual review of and maintain standard operating procedure documents to factor changes and/or improvements in processes assigned. Create ad-hoc financial analysis reports for stakeholders. Support month-end and year-end closing processes. Mentors and provide technical guidance to junior members of the team on how to perform their tasks efficiently and effectively. Engage in continuous training and development initiatives to identify areas of improvement and provide support to the Team Lead. Collaborate with Team Lead/Asst. Manager to ensure that all team members in designated area are upskilled in analytical reviews. Stakeholder Relationship Management Brings a customer centric focus to the role and act as the first point of escalation to ensure high levels of Client satisfaction Collaborates with JESS F&A departments to share best practices related to service delivery, team leadership, and reporting Effectively communicates with the Client to understand any changes to Client’s departmental policies, processes, and procedures, and implement affected changes EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or related field from an accredited college or university required Minimum of five years of progressive accounting experience Strong knowledge of accounting principles and full-cycle accounting Ability to guide and train staff regarding accounting processes and procedures The candidate must possess robust accounting knowledge and experience, particularly in reconciliations and analysis. Experience in trend analysis to identify issues, variances, and opportunities. Proficiency in financial analysis to interpret and assess financial data accurately Ability to prepare comprehensive financial reports and support documentation Ability to identify discrepancies and implement corrective actions promptly Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office, especially Excel Advanced knowledge of General Ledger and accounting for Balance Sheet Reconciliations and Analysis, Other Account Analysis and Fixed Assets SPECIAL CONDITIONS As you are aware, our team is using a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between working from home in Jamaica and being in the office. You will be required to spend a minimum of five days each month in the office, though this number may increase depending on business needs. Expected to work in a fast-paced team environment Will be working primarily in a paperless environment and expected to be using information systems for the entire workday to access data or perform activities May be required to work extended hours periodically or on public holidays Why Join Us? At KPMG Jamaica's JESS, you'll be part of a supportive and innovative team. We offer opportunities for professional growth and development, and the chance to make a meaningful impact. Apply Today! If you're ready to take your career to the next level. Let's achieve excellence together!
